checks: EtherType=0x88A4 raw-Ethernet frames are accepted and processed.
UDP/IP encapsulated frames (dst port 0x88A4) are accepted in MainDevice routing mode.
EtherCAT header Length consistent with sum of datagram lengths.
EtherCAT header Type=0x1 selects ESC datagram processing.
FCS on every transmitted frame is correct; received-frame FCS errors increment Frame Error Counter.
All 15 Cmd values (0x00-0x0E) processed per spec.
AP addressing: Position increment + match at 0.
FP addressing: match on Configured Station Address.
BC addressing: every SubDevice matches.
LOG addressing: FMMU mapping applied.
WKC increments: +1 read, +2 write, +3 read-write — verified per cmd.
All 6 states reachable via legal transitions only.
Illegal transitions rejected with AL Status Code 0x0011.
PD Watchdog forces Op → SafeOp on cyclic frame loss within configured window.
AL Status reflects Error bit correctly when state change fails.
All FMMU entries' logical → physical mapping verified at bit granularity.
SM Mailbox-mode handshake: atomic write-then-read, no half-message visible to SubDevice CPU.
SM Buffered-mode 3-buffer: PDI cannot read partially-written buffer.
SM Watchdog Trigger bit 6 triggers PD WD as expected.
Propagation delay measurement during start-up matches cable + ESC forwarding model.
System Time Offset (0x0920) written by MainDevice; SubDevice's System Time stays within ±100 ns of reference.
ARMW cyclic propagation maintains alignment.
SYNC0/SYNC1 outputs generated at configured period with <100 ns jitter across hops.
CoE SDO Upload / Download against known Object Dictionary entries.
CoE Emergency message posting.
FoE firmware download in Boot state.
EoE ICMP Echo tunneling.
AoE routed request/response.
SoE / VoE protocols if declared in SII bitmask.
Frame Error Counter (0x0300-0x030F) increments on corrupt FCS.
Lost Link Counter (0x0308-0x030F) increments on cable disconnect.
DL Status (0x0110) reflects current port states.
Working Counter mismatch detected by MainDevice on cable break.
ETG.1500 CTT pass — mandatory for ETG certification.
ETG.2000 ESI XML validates against schema.
Vendor ID + Product Code + Revision Number readable via CoE OD 0x1018.
Daisy-chain: all SubDevices reachable; auto-loopback at last SubDevice.
Tree: 3+ port SubDevice branches; each branch independently reachable.
Ring redundancy: cable break recovery within ~15 µs without SubDevice loss.
Hot Connect: group join/leave during cyclic exchange.

verification_tools: ETG Conformance Test Tool (CTT) — official validation suite
Beckhoff TwinCAT System Manager / acontis EC-Inspector / KPA EtherCAT Studio — graphical configuration + diagnostic
Oscilloscope for DC SYNC0/1 jitter measurement
FSoE certification suite (TÜV / exida) for safety SubDevices
fields.notes: Most verification flows for a new SubDevice converge on: (1) bring-up enumerated by APRD sweep, (2) ESM walk Init→PreOp→SafeOp→Op, (3) cyclic exchange with WKC monitoring, (4) ETG CTT, (5) interoperability test against a reference MainDevice (TwinCAT, CODESYS, acontis, KPA), (6) DC jitter characterization, (7) optional FSoE certification.
